scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@game/server & npm run dev --workspace=@game/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/rounds && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:emulator && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-yalla-nelaab "playwright test"
scripts.test:firebase:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-yalla-nelaab "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts apps/web/src/net/firebase-rules.emulator.test.ts"
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-yalla-nelaab "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting,database --project yalla-nelaab-20261016
